reply_text:
I answered Hollis in their #central-team thread. The only deadline on record for Tansley Parcel's signed order form is 25 August, which Pree posted in that channel on 14 October.

The year is still open. Pree didn't give one, and this year's 25 August had already passed. They haven't answered my question about whether they meant 2027, so I told Hollis to confirm the year with Pree before adding it to the account sheet.

Hollis is a member of #central-team and saw Pree's message there. A deadline date isn't a money term, so sharing it with them was fine.
